issue_context.title: Incorrect result when quering on partitioned tables
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

```sql
drop table if exists t1, t2;
create table t1 (c_int int, c_str varchar(40), c_datetime datetime, primary key(c_int));
create table t2 (c_int int, c_str varchar(40), c_datetime datetime, primary key (c_datetime)) partition by range (to_days(c_datetime)) ( partition p0 values less than (to_days('2020-02-01')), partition p1 values less than (to_days('2020-04-01')), partition p2 values less than (to_days('2020-06-01')), partition p3 values less than maxvalue);
insert into t1 (c_int, c_str, c_datetime) values (1, 'xenodochial bassi', '2020-04-29 03:22:51'), (2, 'epic wiles', '2020-01-02 23:29:51'), (3, 'silly burnell', '2020-02-25 07:43:07');
insert into t2 (c_int, c_str, c_datetime) values (1, 'trusting matsumoto', '2020-01-07 00:57:18'), (2, 'pedantic boyd', '2020-06-08 23:12:16'), (null, 'strange hypatia', '2020-05-23 17:45:27');
select * from t1 where c_int != any (select c_int from t2 where t1.c_str <= t2.c_str); -- query repeatedly
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Always return
```
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
| c_int | c_str         | c_datetime          |
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
|     2 | epic wiles    | 2020-01-02 23:29:51 |
|     3 | silly burnell | 2020-02-25 07:43:07 |
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

The result is unstable, sometimes got wrong results.

```
mysql> drop table if exists t1, t2;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.48 sec)

mysql> create table t1 (c_int int, c_str varchar(40), c_datetime datetime, primary key(c_int));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.13 sec)

mysql> create table t2 (c_int int, c_str varchar(40), c_datetime datetime, primary key (c_datetime)) partition by range (to_days(c_datetime)) ( partition p0 values less than (to_days('2020-02-01')), partition p1 values less than (to_days('2020-04-01')), partition p2 values less than (to_days('2020-06-01')), partition p3 values less than maxvalue);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.14 sec)

mysql> insert into t1 (c_int, c_str, c_datetime) values (1, 'xenodochial bassi', '2020-04-29 03:22:51'), (2, 'epic wiles', '2020-01-02 23:29:51'), (3, 'silly burnell', '2020-02-25 07:43:07');
Query OK, 3 rows affected (0.05 sec)
Records: 3  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

mysql> insert into t2 (c_int, c_str, c_datetime) values (1, 'trusting matsumoto', '2020-01-07 00:57:18'), (2, 'pedantic boyd', '2020-06-08 23:12:16'), (null, 'strange hypatia', '2020-05-23 17:45:27');
Query OK, 3 rows affected (0.05 sec)
Records: 3  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

mysql> select * from t1 where c_int != any (select c_int from t2 where t1.c_str <= t2.c_str);
+-------+------------+---------------------+
| c_int | c_str      | c_datetime          |
+-------+------------+---------------------+
|     2 | epic wiles | 2020-01-02 23:29:51 |
+-------+------------+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.06 sec)

mysql> select * from t1 where c_int != any (select c_int from t2 where t1.c_str <= t2.c_str);
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
| c_int | c_str         | c_datetime          |
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
|     2 | epic wiles    | 2020-01-02 23:29:51 |
|     3 | silly burnell | 2020-02-25 07:43:07 |
+-------+---------------+---------------------+
2 rows in set (0.05 sec)

mysql> select * from t1 where c_int != any (select c_int from t2 where t1.c_str <= t2.c_str);
+-------+------------+---------------------+
| c_int | c_str      | c_datetime          |
+-------+------------+---------------------+
|     2 | epic wiles | 2020-01-02 23:29:51 |
+-------+------------+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.06 sec)

```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

master @ fa6baa9f5321d88f81a99e56af00526643e7bcaa
release-4.0 @ 51d365fc45fdfc039eb204a96268c5bd1c55075f
comments:
This seems to be related to concurrent executor.
On the master, after setting 

```
mysql> set @@tidb_executor_concurrency = 1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
```

The result is correct and stable.

I modify the code and set the concurrency to 1, and `set @@tidb_executor_concurrency = 4`
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/executor/executor.go#L1390

The bug also disappears, so there is a chance this bug has something to do with the concurrent execution of `UnionExec`.

Another finding, I wrap `UnionExec.Next` to print the data

```
// Next implements the Executor Next interface.
func (e *UnionExec) Next(ctx context.Context, req *chunk.Chunk) error {
	err := e.NextO(ctx, req)
	for i:=0; i< req.NumRows(); i++ {
		row := req.GetRow(i)
		datums := row.GetDatumRow(e.base().retFieldTypes)
		for c, datum := range datums {
			str, err := datum.ToString()
			if err != nil {
				return errors.Trace(err)
			}
			fmt.Printf("%d:%s ", c, str)
		}
		fmt.Println("= Union =========", i)
	}
	fmt.Println("now ===")
	return err
}
```


In the correct case, UnionExec's output is

```
0:1 1:trusting matsumoto 2:2020-01-07 00:57:18 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0: 1:strange hypatia 2:2020-05-23 17:45:27 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0:2 1:pedantic boyd 2:2020-06-08 23:12:16 = Union ========= 0
now ===
now ===
0:1 1:trusting matsumoto 2:2020-01-07 00:57:18 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0: 1:strange hypatia 2:2020-05-23 17:45:27 = Union ========= 0
```

in the wrong case, the output is:

```
0:1 1:trusting matsumoto 2:2020-01-07 00:57:18 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0: 1:strange hypatia 2:2020-05-23 17:45:27 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0:2 1:pedantic boyd 2:2020-06-08 23:12:16 = Union ========= 0
now ===
now ===
0: 1:strange hypatia 2:2020-05-23 17:45:27 = Union ========= 0
now ===
0:1 1:trusting matsumoto 2:2020-01-07 00:57:18 = Union ========= 0
now ===
```

Note the different order in the last two lines

```
0: 1:strange hypatia 2:2020-05-23 17:45:27 = Union ========= 0
0:1 1:trusting matsumoto 2:2020-01-07 00:57:18 = Union ========= 0
```

Union executor does not keep order in partition table, does the upper executor requires ordering?  @wshwsh12

Plan:
```
[tidb]> desc select * from t1 where c_int != any (select c_int from t2 where t1.c_str <= t2.c_str);
+----------------------------------------+----------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                                     | estRows  | task      | access object          | operator info                                                                                                                             |
+----------------------------------------+----------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_17                          | 8000.00  | root      |                        | test.t1.c_int, test.t1.c_str, test.t1.c_datetime                                                                                          |
| └─Apply_19                             | 8000.00  | root      |                        | CARTESIAN inner join, other cond:or(gt(Column#8, 1), or(ne(test.t1.c_int, Column#7), if(ne(Column#9, 0), NULL, 0)))                       |
|   ├─TableReader_22(Build)              | 8000.00  | root      |                        | data:Selection_21                                                                                                                         |
|   │ └─Selection_21                     | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                        | if(isnull(test.t1.c_int), NULL, 1)                                                                                                        |
|   │   └─TableFullScan_20               | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1               | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                                                                            |
|   └─Selection_23(Probe)                | 0.80     | root      |                        | ne(Column#10, 0)                                                                                                                          |
|     └─StreamAgg_25                     | 1.00     | root      |                        | funcs:firstrow(Column#13)->Column#7, funcs:count(distinct Column#14)->Column#8, funcs:sum(Column#15)->Column#9, funcs:count(1)->Column#10 |
|       └─Projection_52                  | 32000.00 | root      |                        | test.t2.c_int, test.t2.c_int, cast(isnull(test.t2.c_int), decimal(65,0) BINARY)->Column#15                                                |
|         └─PartitionUnion_39            | 32000.00 | root      |                        |                                                                                                                                           |
|           ├─TableReader_42             | 8000.00  | root      |                        | data:Selection_41                                                                                                                         |
|           │ └─Selection_41             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                        | le(test.t1.c_str, test.t2.c_str)                                                                                                          |
|           │   └─TableFullScan_40       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2, partition:p0 | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                                                                            |
|           ├─TableReader_45             | 8000.00  | root      |                        | data:Selection_44                                                                                                                         |
|           │ └─Selection_44             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                        | le(test.t1.c_str, test.t2.c_str)                                                                                                          |
|           │   └─TableFullScan_43       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2, partition:p1 | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                                                                            |
|           ├─TableReader_48             | 8000.00  | root      |                        | data:Selection_47                                                                                                                         |
|           │ └─Selection_47             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                        | le(test.t1.c_str, test.t2.c_str)                                                                                                          |
|           │   └─TableFullScan_46       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2, partition:p2 | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                                                                            |
|           └─TableReader_51             | 8000.00  | root      |                        | data:Selection_50                                                                                                                         |
|             └─Selection_50             | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |                        | le(test.t1.c_str, test.t2.c_str)                                                                                                          |
|               └─TableFullScan_49       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2, partition:p3 | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                                                                                                            |
+----------------------------------------+----------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
21 rows in set (0.001 sec)
```
Root Cause:
`funcs:firstrow(Column#13)->Column#7` maybe return NULL/1, and it will make the condition :`or(gt(Column#8, 1), or(ne(test.t1.c_int, Column#7), if(ne(Column#9, 0), NULL, 0)))`  result unstable.
